summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`) of the CipherBox project using the GSD workflow — research, produce 4 PLAN.md files across 2 waves, verify them, then begin wave-based execution.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (4 plans, 2 waves, 0 blockers, HARD-09 covered, D-01..D-13 addressed). Execution started but the 58-01 executor crashed at ~60% completion due to an API socket error; 3 of 5 tasks were committed, task 3 was done-but-uncommitted, task 4 (sdk-core JS binding) was not started. A continuation executor was spawned to recover.

repo: Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`): 4 plans, 2 waves, TDD mode, fine granularity, feature branch `feat/ipns-signature-verify-coverage`.
`crates/crypto` cannot dev-depend on `api-client` or `core` — Rust cross-language verify vectors must live in `crates/fuse/tests/` to avoid a dependency cycle.
58-02 has a mandatory human checkpoint at the D-10 full-SDK-E2E gate; local stack (docker compose + API, redis:6380) must be up for it to run.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` heading must be suffixed `(RESOLVED)` once all questions are addressed in-plan, or the plan checker emits a cosmetic warning.
The `commit_failed` signal from the GSD commit helper is a known false negative — always verify with `git log` rather than retrying the commit.

code.finding: New file introduced in 58-01: Rust `resolve_ipns_verified` chokepoint wrapper that imports `ciborium`. A stale diagnostic falsely flagged ciborium as missing; `crates/fuse/Cargo.toml:43` already had the dep.
`ciborium` dependency added as part of 58-01 task 0 (cborg dep commit).

workflow: For delicate multi-crate crypto phases, sequential executors on the feature branch are preferred over parallel worktree execution to avoid cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees.
When an executor crashes mid-run, assess disk/git state (uncommitted diffs + `git log`) before spawning a continuation — partial commits may have landed even if the completion signal was lost.
The GSD plan checker's cosmetic warnings (doc heading conventions) are safe to fix directly without re-running the planner, saving a full planner revision cycle.
AUTO_MODE (`--auto`) suppresses checkpoint prompts; `--no-transition` suppresses automatic routing to the next phase after completion.

friction: API socket error killed the 58-01 executor mid-execution, requiring manual git/disk state triage and a continuation subagent spawn.
Stale in-flight diagnostic reported `ciborium` missing from `crates/fuse` even though `Cargo.toml` already had the dependency, causing unnecessary investigation.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` heading was not auto-marked `(RESOLVED)` by the researcher, surfacing as a plan-checker warning that required a manual edit.
